sentences.text:
Brief facts of the case:
3. The complainant is the brother of the victim and lodged a complaint stating that his sister namely Gavisiddamma D/o Mahantappa Mangalore studied upto 10th standard and thereafter she discontinued her studies and she was assisting in agricultural works and also staying with her parents.
On 03.02.2024, when he had been to Mundaragi on his work, his father had informed him that the victim was not found in the house since NC: 2024:KHC-D:7778 03.02.2024 around 12.00 a.m.
Immediately, he came back to home and searched the whereabouts of the victim, as they could not get any information, lodged a complaint against unknown persons.

The jurisdictional police have registered a case in crime No.8/2024 and after conducting the investigation, submitted the chargesheet by incorporating Sections 363, 376(2)(n) of IPC and Section 6 of the POCSO Act, 2012.
4. The facts of the case has been unfolded in such a way that the petitioner when she was going to work, used to take her in his auto and both have developed intimacy.
Such being the fact, he proposed her for marriage.
Then the victim has refused the said offer by stating that she was minor and she was not willing to go along with him.
Again, the petitioner herein continued to talk with her and also showing some interest towards her.
The petitioner somehow managed to induce the victim and obtained consent by inducing the victim and took her along with him on his motorcycle on 03.02.2024 around 12.00 a.m.

After taking the victim, the petitioner made her NC:
2024:KHC-D:7778 to stay in the land near his native.
Both the victim and petitioner stayed in the shed which is situated in the said land.
In the said land, the petitioner herein stated to have committed sexual assault.
Thereafter on the following day, he took the victim from there near Mudhol village and there stayed in one asbestos shed till evening and there also he said to have committed sexual assault.
Thereafter, he took the victim on his motorcycle to Gajendragada.
From Gajendragada both have traveled to Bengaluru.
Both said to have stayed in Bengaluru for 2-3 days and thereafter she insisted him to take her back to her village and on request he brought her back to her village and went away.
After recording the statement of the victim and also after conducting the investigation, the jurisdictional police submitted chargesheet.

sentences.text: It is the submission of the learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner was not aware about the actual age of the victim properly.
In fact the victim had convinced the petitioner that she had completed 18 years and asked him for the marriage.

As per the statement of NC:
2024:KHC-D:7778 the victim, the victim came out of the house at odd hours that itself would indicates that she voluntarily went along with the petitioner.
6. It is further submitted that the petitioner after coming to know the actual age of the victim, he brought her back to her village and asked her to go to her parents house.
The victim in order to marry the petitioner made a false statement stating that she has been committed rape by the petitioner.

7. It is further submitted that the petitioner is aged about 21 years and working as auto driver and resident of Lakamanagule village, Yelburga taluq and he is the earning member of the family and he will abide the conditions imposed by this Court in the event of his release on bail.
8.
Per contra, the learned HCGP vehemently opposed the bail petition and submitted that the petitioner has committed sexual assault against minor girl.

Since he has committed heinous offence,
he is not entitled for any NC: 2024:KHC-D:7778 relief.
Making such submission, the learned HCGP prays to dismiss the petition.

9. Having heard the learned counsel for respective parties and also perused the averments of the chargesheet, it appears that the victim studied upto 10th standard and after discontinuing her studies she was going for coolie work along with her parents.
10. It is further noticed that the petitioner being an auto driver used to take her to her working place on everyday and stated to have developed intimacy and proposed her for marriage.
As per the advice of the petitioner, the victim came out of the house in the mid night at 12.00 a.m. and went along with the petitioner.

As per the documents annexed along with the petition and also averments of the chargesheet which would indicate that the petitioner and the victim stayed at different places for six days and thereafter, they came back to their respective areas.

11. On perusal of the chargesheet, I am of the considered opinion that the submission of the learned NC: 2024:KHC-D:7778 counsel for the petitioner that he was not aware about the actual age of the victim appears to be true and the petitioner is entitled for bail.
12. Hence, I proceed to pass the following order.
ORDER The petition is allowed.

The petitioner is ordered to be enlarged on bail in Crime No.8/2024 of Bevoor Police Station on the file of Addl. District and Sessions Judge, FTSC-1, Koppal, on executing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One lakh only) with one surety for the likesum to the satisfaction of the Trial Court, subject to the following conditions:
